query: I just got back from walking my golden retriever earlier, he stopped to sniff every single dandelion on the sidewalk and even tried to steal a piece of fried chicken someone dropped on the curb. Then I swung by the corner bakery and picked up a matcha croissant that was still warm, it was so flaky it crumbled all over my jacket when I took the first bite. I also spent half an hour this afternoon rearranging the succulents on my windowsill, one of my echeverias grew a little offshoot that I'm thinking of propagating next weekend. I need to process a return for my delivered order #W4680753, the item I want to return is 9690244451, and please refund the amount to my paypal_2417743 payment method.
